content.title: RH Stock Drops After Furniture Seller Cuts Outlook
content.summary: RH trimmed its annual revenue guidance, as the luxury home-furnishings seller struggles with tariff-related costs.    The company now expects annual revenue growth of 9% to 11%, down from prior guidance of 10% to 13%.
